shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md; printf '\\n--- package files ---\\n'; rg --files -g 'package.json' -g 'registry.ts' -g '*.test.ts' -g 'spec.md' | head -80; printf '\\n--- lore tools ---\\n'; text(ALL_TOOLS.filter(x=>x.name.toLowerCase().includes('lore')).map(x=>x.name+' :: '+x.description).join('\\n'));"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts; printf '\\n--- unit test ---\\n'; sed -n '1,320p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts; printf '\\n--- spec ---\\n'; sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md; printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short; git log -4 --oneline --decorate; git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts; sed -n '1,120p' .lore/test-commands.yml; rg -n \"spec:|validated by\" src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | head -30"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npx jest src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts -t "compiles a static schema once at registration and reuses it across executions" --runInBand'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules timeout 300 npx jest src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts -t "compiles a static schema once at registration and reuses it across executions" --runInBand'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md; nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '180,235p'; git diff --check; git diff --stat; git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check; git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md; git commit -m "test tools static schema validator reuse"; git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main; git merge origin/main; merge_status=$?; if [ "$merge_status" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$merge_status"; fi; git push origin HEAD; git status --short --branch'
